meta.note: Scaffold placeholders for IB AA HL/SL past papers. No copyrighted paper text or PDFs in git. Diploma Practice banks (~4000) are separate generated skill drills. Exam skill-drill mode elsewhere uses MCQ A–E.

notes: Sessions May/Nov; TZ1/TZ2 can be attached locally later.
Timing defaults: SL P1/P2 90m; HL P1/P2 120m; HL P3 60m — confirm against any future cover sheet.
Local PDF attach uses IndexedDB on /diploma/exams/; binaries never commit.
